body.p: A Git stash temporarily saves the changes in your working copy. Use a stash when you need a clean working copy for another Git operation and you want to reapply the changes later.

The toolbar includes a Stash drop-down menu. Use Stash changes to create a stash from the changed files in the working copy. Use List stashes to open a dialog box that lists existing stashes. From this dialog box, you can apply or remove a stash.
